title: 216th Engineer Fire Fighting Detachment mission role
description: U.S. Army Cpt. Christian Trainor, the 216th Engineer Fire Fighting Detachment and  Army Support Activity-Black Sea Garrison Fire Marshal, explains the role for the ASA Black Sea Fire Department at Mihail Kogalniceanu Air Base, Romania, Nov. 15, 2023. The fire department at ASA Black Sea is responsible for providing fire protection and emergency services to the base and its surrounding areas, along with inspections throughout the installation to ensure fire prevention. (U.S. Army Reserve video by Spc. Andrew Mendoza)
keywords: EUCOM, readiness, U.S.Army, StrongerTogether, VictoryCorps, asablacksea
